Long signals are weakly positive and should be discounted, especially for higher-beta assets. Fragile signals: ETC/USD is unusable because price, volatility, liquidity, and expected shortfall are all zero; BCH/USD, DOGE/USD, and LTC/USD have flat council directions with negative alpha and weak institutional/liquidity support. ETH/USD and SOL/USD are also fragile due to high beta and volatility. BTC/USD is the most resilient signal but remains exposed to the stressed regime.
